caption: The drawing depicts a single, folded handkerchief positioned slightly diagonally on a plain, neutral background. The handkerchief is a pale, beige or off-white color and has scalloped edges decorated with a repeating series of small, round elements that appear to be embroidered or drawn in a darker shade. In one visible corner of the handkerchief, there is an intricate floral and foliage embroidery pattern rendered in a similar darker tone, consisting of small circular motifs and curving lines grouped in a stylized, decorative arrangement. The overall composition centers the handkerchief on the page, and there are no other objects present in the drawing.
